name: Booking and tap-to-call gaps on local service websites

offer.title: Mobile homepage fix: tap-to-call and a clear online booking path
offer.summary: A concept of your own homepage's top section on a phone, with a tap-to-call button and a booking button.
offer.paid_next_step: Implement the booking button and tap-to-call on the live site, connected to the booking tool they already use or a free one.
offer.deliverable: One-page concept mockup (image or private link)

target.description: Owner-led local service businesses (clinics, salons, home services) whose site makes visitors call or email to book.

filters.exclude_name_pattern: aspen dental|great clips|supercuts|sport clips|massage envy|european wax

checks.label: Online booking link or button
checks.problem: No online booking path found on the checked pages

checks.label: Tap-to-call phone link
checks.problem: Phone number is not a tap-to-call link

checks.label: Active ads in the Meta Ad Library
checks.instructions: Open https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?active_status=active&ad_type=all&country=US&q=<business name>. If they have active ads, record --hit yes with that URL as --source-url. A signal of marketing spend, not proof.

hypotheses: Some visitors may prefer to book online instead of calling during opening hours. Not measured for this business.

sample.label: Concept mockup using text and images from your current website. Not live, not published.
sample.instructions: Recreate the top of their homepage at phone width using their real logo, headline and colors from the brief's assets, then add a 'Call now' tap-to-call button and a 'Book online' button. Export a PNG (or a private HTML link). No invented offers, prices, reviews or awards.

message.guidance: Name the one thing you saw on the pages you checked (no booking link; phone not tap-to-call), show the mockup, offer to set it up. One question at the end.
